name: No Fishing at Science Level 2
description: **Needs no other patch.** Makes fishing come later, so the game is harder; off by default. In the base game buying Science level 2 (8,000 tech points) makes the Clothing Hut's building site appear, and the Clothing Hut is what lets your villagers make cloth (Cloth Invented) and mend the fishing nets with it (Fishing Nets) -- so fish come early. With this patch the Clothing Hut's site appears only at Science level 3 (70,000 tech points). A village whose Clothing Hut site is already showing, with or without some building done, while Science is below 3 gets the site locked again: it disappears and nobody builds it until Science reaches 3; then it comes back in the same place with all the building it already had. Nothing is reset or lost. (A site with no building done yet has no points to keep: at Science 3 the game places it itself, as it places any new site, so it may appear in a different spot.) A Clothing Hut that is already finished is never affected. If you remove this patch while a partly built Clothing Hut is hidden below Science 3, the normal game restarts a site with under 400 points from 0.
behavior_changes: The Clothing Hut's site (project 22, object 0x4D82D8) is revealed by its predicate 0x430CF0 at Science 3 (stock: Science 2, i.e. above 1), and only while it was never built on.

Below Science 3 an unfinished Clothing Hut site that shows (state not 4) is relocked by the update 0x4300E0 (path 0x430156): state 4, its map area erased by the game's own 0x430490; at Science 3 it returns to state 3 in the same place and is repainted. Its progress (0x4D8CA8) is never written.

Below Science 3 project 22's percent (0x438980) is below 1, so the Building dispatcher (0x463E49) and Builders Fix Huts When Idle never offer it, live or while catching up; a villager on task 15 (building it) drops the task (0x46378D).
explicit_non_changes: A finished Clothing Hut, every other building, the tech prices, Cloth Invented and Fishing Nets themselves are unchanged; no save data is written by the patch beyond the site's own state.
Guarded edits in place: two rewritten stock routines (0x430156, 0x430CF0), one vtable entry, one call, and int3 padding between routines; no executable tail space is claimed.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the reveal at Science 1/2/3, the relock of a showing site (0 to 1,999 points) and its return at Science 3, a finished hut, project 22's percent and the task-15 continuation are emulated stock and patched on the game's own Clothing Hut object and map in tests/test_vv4_no_fishing_at_science_2.py; runtime/player confirmation pending
